data.title: 诗怀雅 · 伞下慢一点
data.description: 她把伞往你这边偏，又伸手将你拉近，嘴上仍催你跟上，唇角却忍不住扬起来。
data.action: 撑伞回眸，伸手拉近对方
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Under a steady Lungmen drizzle, Swire holds a wide canopy umbrella and looks back over her shoulder, extending an impatient yet caring hand to pull the viewer into the dry space. Vivid neon reflections streak across the rain-slicked asphalt around them.
data.animaCaption: Tipping the umbrella over the viewer, she tugs their sleeve with a feigned scowl that quickly gives way to a fond, playful smile.
